facts.title: corrective action following ICAM investigation at P-4101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on P-4101, TK-4211 and TT-4101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically gas testing before and during hot work. P-4101 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during routine operation while the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 17 January 2021 a corrective action on P-4101, TK-4211 and TT-4101 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
